responsibility: Checks MIR locals that represent function, closure, and coroutine inputs and outputs against the normalized signature and any explicit user signature annotations, including closure-specific instantiation and async-closure adjustments, by ascribing user types and equating them with MIR-declared types. It is specifically responsible for equating coroutine yield and resume MIR types with the coroutine signature seen by borrowck. This includes checking the `Yield` terminator's resume argument type against the coroutine resume type, so lifetime-sensitive resume values such as invariant generic arguments are rejected when the yielded-back value does not match the declared resume type.
